The full normal mission was held near station 4522.452364466207 m, lateral offset 1.7824786075884287 m, heading 42.97892234985278 degrees, latitude 37.59115610517239, longitude -122.36081625291811. The green interpretation is tested from pixels only; node association uses recorded location/kind priors, never world phase. Housing broad-head bbox is (505,120,516,156). Three resolved lenses are each 3 x 8 pixels. Projected lens aspect support 0.25-0.5 approximately corresponds to 60-75 degree planar incidence under weak perspective; no measured angle or real-camera guarantee is implied. The .75 shape-quality score is an uncalibrated qualifying heuristic, not recognition accuracy. The pipeline unit test replays this single image at synthetic distinct capture times to test confirmation mechanics; live temporal behavior requires separate browser validation.
